title: Prayer to the Immaculate Heart of Mary
text:
O Immaculate Heart of Mary,
heavenly beauty and splendor of the Father,
you are the most valued work of his hands.
You are the glorious Mother of the Son,
and the masterpiece of the Holy Spirit.
You are the temple of the Most Blessed Trinity,
the paradise of the eternal King,
the throne of the Almighty,
the city and palace of the great God.

O Immaculate Heart of Mary,
noble resting place of the Word made flesh,
you are spotless and holy,
all beautiful and perfect.
You are the Mother of fair love,
the Mother of grace and mercy.

Protect us, purify us, consecrate us to your Son.
Reign over us, teach us how to make Jesus
reign and triumph in us and around us,
as he has reigned and triumphed in you,
for the glory of the Father.
Amen.

Immaculate Heart of Mary, pray for us.
Immaculate Heart of Mary, pray for us now and at the hour of our death.

translation.latin:
O Cor Immaculatum Mariae,
caelestis pulchritudo et splendor Patris,
tu es pretiosissimum opus manuum eius.
Tu es gloriosa Mater Filii,
et opus praeclarum Spiritus Sancti.
Tu es templum Sanctissimae Trinitatis,
paradisus aeterni Regis,
thronus Omnipotentis,
civitas et palatium magni Dei.

O Cor Immaculatum Mariae,
nobile requies Verbi incarnati,
tu es immaculata et sancta,
tota pulchra et perfecta.
Tu es Mater pulchri amoris,
Mater gratiae et misericordiae.

Protege nos, purifica nos, consecra nos Filio tuo.
Regna super nos, doce nos facere Iesum
regnare et triumphare in nobis et circa nos,
sicut regnavit et triumphavit in te,
ad gloriam Patris.
Amen.

Cor Immaculatum Mariae, ora pro nobis.
Cor Immaculatum Mariae, ora pro nobis nunc et in hora mortis nostrae.

attribution: Traditional Marian devotion, promoted especially at Fatima (1917)
notes: Devotion to the Immaculate Heart of Mary is closely linked with the Sacred Heart of Jesus. At Fatima, Our Lady requested devotion to her Immaculate Heart as a means of peace and conversion. This prayer acknowledges Mary's perfect love and asks for her maternal protection and intercession.
